name: Blobular
storyline: Enter planet Moduland. A strange, purple world inhabited colorful, joyous, modular and blobular creatures! Play the role of a researcher, tasked with studying the strange life of Moduland. The way you, the player, treat each individual blob directly affect how they grow up; Poke them too much and they become sad, feed them a lot and they become bigger, chase them around and they become speedy!
summary: Blobular is a simulation virtual-pet game. You are tasked with researching these strange Blob creatures. Take care of and mess around with your blobs, how you interact with each individual blob will influence how they grow up by changing their looks, color and personality!
